welcomeMessage:
🚨 Group me share hone wali duties alag-alag groups se forward hoti hain, isliye kisi ko bhi bina jaane ya verify kiye advance payment na karein.

⚠️ Free aur Exchange wale messages allowed nahi hain.

🙏 Agar kisi duty ya number par fraud ka doubt lage, toh uska number mujhe personal message kar dein.
